report.areaHint: Required when there is no GPS fix.

report.needArea: No GPS fix — choose the area.

report.needWhatYouDid: Say what you did to fix it.

report.savedPending: Kept on this phone. The number arrives when it reaches the server.
report.willTell: We will tell you when it is fixed.
photo.notImage: That file is not a photo.
photo.markupHint: Drag a box over anything that should not be readable. Blur is burnt into the photo before upload and cannot be undone after submit.

qr.title: Report a hazard
qr.chooseLanguageSub: No sign-in needed. Takes about 30 seconds.
qr.noToken: Scan the QR poster in your area to open the report form.
qr.badToken: This QR code is no longer active. Ask the site safety officer for the new poster.
qr.offline: No connection — you can still fill the form. It is sent when the signal is back.
qr.queued: {count, plural, one {# report on this phone waiting to send} other {# reports on this phone waiting to send}}
qr.anonymousHint: Nothing about you is stored. If you switch this off you can leave a name and phone, visible only to the site safety team.
qr.name: Your name
qr.phoneHint: So the safety officer can call you back. Stored encrypted.

qr.willSend: It will be sent automatically when the signal is back. Keep this page open or come back to it.
qr.photosDone: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}}
qr.statusHint: Only someone with this link can see the status. Save it to follow what happens.
qr.statusNotFound: No report matches this link. Check the case number and the secret in the link.
qr.statusPrivacy: This page shows only the status — never who reported it.
